events.title: 500+ Wishlists in 7 Days! Thank You!
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who played the demo and added Trust the System to their wishlist! As a solo developer making my first Steam game, this means the world to me.Development is moving forward!I'm currently working on additional languages, keybindings, accessibility settings, and other QoL features.Thank you for your support!If you haven't wishlisted Trust the System yet, now is a great time to do so. Also, leaving a review helps out immensely!And do not forget to trust the System...

events.title: Trust the System demo is here!
events.summary: Time for you to work, the demo is now available on Windows & Mac!The demo features about 40 minutes of gameplay, giving you a taste of the core mechanics and what the full game will feel like. Stamp papers, earn points, venture beyond your desk, unlock upgrades, and piece together the dark reality behind your job.I can't wait to hear what you think! If you have any feedback, let me know in the comments, on Steam discussions, or directly through this form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQ
